pseudocode_corrections: The Game Explorer out pointer and the language string object share the frame+0x8 slot; local_c48 is the interface pointer early and the string length late, and iStack_c44 is the string data pointer.
The DAT_01090aa0 branch does not return: 008f845b falls through to 008f8460, which clears the global and continues into CloseHandle.
BSP_RandomThreads_Shutdown is not confined to the no-slot branch; both branches converge on 008f8486.
unresolved_edges: The options tokenizer at 008d8a70, 008d8960, 008d99f0 and 008d9f20 is not reconstructed, so end-of-file behavior after a trailing Language key is unestablished.
The delimiter set at 00d15f2c is adjacent to the Language literal but no reference to it from this routine was proven.
The native GDF path buffer has 0xc10 bytes for a 0xbfe directory plus a 26 character suffix, an eight byte shortfall at the maximum; reachability was not investigated.
0041e870 is leased to packet app_initialize_map and was not renamed.
The meaning of the literal zero first argument to BSP_Application_Initialize and of the flags at +18 through +1a is unresolved.
The one byte per-thread random slot value is never read; it only gates the register and unregister pair.
